name: Amplitude Experiment
description: Amplitude Experiment provides feature flags, controlled rollouts, targeting, A/B experiments, variants, deployments, and experiment configuration management.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated Amplitude Experiment management API key, region, and one project ID. Relay mounts four approval-gated read-only operations for bounded active flag and experiment lists and exact configuration inspection.

credentialRequirements.name: AMPLITUDE_EXPERIMENT_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Amplitude Experiment management API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated read-only management key; deployment keys are not accepted.

credentialRequirements.name: AMPLITUDE_EXPERIMENT_PROJECT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Amplitude Experiment project ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind Relay to one non-production project.

capabilities.label: Read experiments and flags
capabilities.description: List bounded active configurations or inspect one exact configuration with approval.

approvalRequired.label: Read Amplitude experiment configuration
approvalRequired.description: List bounded active flags/experiments or inspect one exact configuration.

blocked.label: Expose keys
blocked.description: Management API keys, deployment keys, authorization headers, and credential-bearing fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Read targeting inclusions
blocked.description: Variant user/device inclusions, cohort inclusions, identities, evaluation payloads, and assignment data are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate experimentation
blocked.description: Flag, experiment, variant, inclusion, cohort, deployment, version, rollout, target, schedule, run, archive, and project mutations remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only four pinned GET routes run on an enumerated US or EU origin and one stored project; arbitrary paths, projects, regions, cursors, archived resources, queries, and oversized results are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All selected configuration reads require approval; exact project/region binding, active-only list caps, response bounds, audits, and key/inclusion/mutation blocks remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All four selected reads run without Relay per-action approval; exact project/region binding, active-only list caps, response bounds, audits, and key/inclusion/mutation blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches the encrypted management key server-side and mounts four bounded project-bound reads.

providerSetup.blocker: Amplitude Experiment requires a customer organization/project, a dedicated management API key with access to one non-production project, and the correct US or EU residency. No console, project, key, flag, experiment, deployment, user inclusion, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated least-privilege staging management key outside this worker, configure the key, region, and project ID in Railway staging, then verify project/region isolation, all four reads, approval and access denial, active-only/list/response bounds, rate limits, key revocation, pause/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

Amplitude documents bounded experiment list/get routes, active/archive and delivery filters, versions/variants/inclusions, rollout configuration, and mutation surfaces excluded by Relay.
